_comment: Per-Island decor art keys (Art/Incoming keys) used by the editor builders (IslandDecor.cs). IslandCoastBuilder.BuildBoundary: 'trees' replaces deco_tree on the playable-edge ring, 'props' replaces the green bush there, 'bigProps' are 2-cell props mixed into those spots (30 %); 'lip' is the Island's own W/E/N edge lip used as drawn (IslandDressingBuilder.EdgeLipTiles, else the shared lip recoloured); 'floes' are ice floes stamped on the pond water (IslandDressingBuilder.EnsurePond); 'swaps' give this Island its own art for a shared node / fixture key (ArtIntake.Integrate; the '_flow' loop of the new key comes with it). A key that is not in Art/Incoming falls back to the default art. A key delivered in two frame sizes is also reachable as '<key>_<W>x<H>'. ART-SPEC 3.8 (snowy Fishing).
